news.text: ❌❓"At this moment, as far as #Fofana-#Juventus is concerned, I have no concrete situations to tell you about."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤⁉️ "#Juventus has called the entourage of both #Suzuki and Emiliano #Martínez. Meanwhile, they are still keeping #Vicario, #Trubin, #Ederson and others on standby. There is a stalemate: there are still two goalkeepers in the squad and it is necessary to sell #DiGregorio, a fundamental step. The turnaround is important because, if the Japanese goes to #AstonVilla, we still need to understand whether he goes there to be a backup goalkeeper due to the Argentine's physical problems or if the latter could leave."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤⁉️ "#Trubin is highly liked, but #Benfica is asking for €40M: too expensive for #Juventus's financial capabilities. They could therefore return to #Vicario, who is liked, even if, considering #Spalletti's words, he probably does not convince 100%. He could arrive only on loan without an obligation to buy, whereas this is a willingness that #Tottenham for now does not have. However, it could be the player who lends a hand, trying to soften the English's position and favor the transfer."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👋🔜 "#DiGregorio could be close to #Valencia, the club that has moved the most. A deal that could be structured around a loan with an obligation to buy of approximately €15M, conditioned on the achievement of certain personal goals. The problem slowing everything down is that #Juventus does not yet have any replacement, the starting goalkeeper: they are waiting for this."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴 "#Bologna, at the moment, is standing very firm on the loan with an option to buy for Juan David #Cabal.#Juventus is trying to force an obligation to buy, but the rossoblù club has 2 or 3 other names on the mercato list to cover that role. The reasoning they are making is that if #Juve gives him on loan with an option to buy, #Bologna would make an effort on the salary level, because he earns €1.3-1.4M and it is by no means a low salary for the Emilia-Romagnia club."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀❗️"In these hours, there is talk above all of swap deals with #Milan for #Fofana and among the possible ideas, #Gatti could be included. If #Juventus finds the missing piece, a way to place him and perhaps bring home a player more functional to #Spalletti's technical project, by fishing from the rossoneri, they can do these types of deals. For the bianconero defender, #Napoli could also manifest itself at the end of the mercato."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

For greater clarity: #AVFC continues to ask for an important figure for #Martinez and, at the same time, the finger problem could force him to undergo a surgery with long recovery times. Therefore, it remains a decidedly complicated deal.[Alessio Lento]

At the current state, no contact between Juan #Musso's entourage and #Juventus. As anticipated by other sources, #DibuMartinez has come back into fashion with #AVFC veering toward #Suzuki after the breakdown with #PSG. #calciomercato jigsaw puzzle[Alessio Lento]

#AVFC wanted to keep Emi Martinez & felt they would (even said so, publicly). Yet, despite the many words, Martinez has wanted to go for two years. Villa have sought contingencies throughout summer (Risser, Suzuki, who they believe wanted to join from early on) in the event Martinez goes & now he is in talks to do so, they've turned very, very quickly & very excited by Suzuki[Jacob Tanswell]

There is no pivot by #Juventus from #Vicario to #DibuMartinez, at least not yet. #Carnevali is continuing to work with #Tottenham on the loan of #Vicario, while still monitoring the #Suzuki situation. At la Continassa, they are in a hurry to close as soon as possible with the best solution, avoiding arriving at the end of the #calciomercato with the risk of being left empty handed.[Giovanni Albanese]

Zion #Suzuki is currently getting closer to #AstonVilla, which are ready to pay €30M + bonuses to #Parma to sign the goalkeeper. For the japanese ready a contract until 2031. #transfers #AVFC[Nico Schira]

👋🔚 "#Juventus is working hard on #DiGregorio's exit: they believe the conditions no longer exist for him to be serene in Turin. It is clear that the situation is complicated and therefore solutions are being sought. There was a call from #Monza, two clubs from abroad have also called and they are working on his exit. As soon as the new goalkeeper arrives, he will say goodbye as well. This is the jigsaw puzzle."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🚨⚪️⚫️ Discussions between Juventus and Dibu Martinez not at advanced stages after today’s call.Dibu suffered from physical issues during World Cup and Juve are considering more goalkeepers.Meanwhile, Aston Villa keep advancing on Zion Suzuki deal. 🟣🔵🇯🇵[Fabrizio Romano]

🇦🇷🧐 "#Juventus, after learning that the #Suzuki-#PSG deal had collapsed and of #AstonVilla's intervention, called to understand if the path for Emiliano #Martínez could be re-opened. However, a physical unknown remains: he played the World Cup with a serious problem in his finger and that pain is still there. It is necessary to go slowly: the call took place, but it does not mean that a negotiation has already started. The Villains will have to evaluate the price and physical aspect. For now, it is by no means a given that he could become a bianconero."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇯🇵❌ "I am not aware of #Juventus having called back for #Suzuki. The bianconero club knows that he can only be signed on a permanent basis and that €35M must be paid. Today the management is not putting that figure toward the goalkeeper. Therefore, we must set this topic aside."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 New attempt by #Juventus for Emiliano #Martínez. There are still no signs of a concrete re-opening, which is naturally tied to the possible arrival of #Suzuki, on whom #AstonVilla has returned strongly after the deal with #PSG stalled. In addition to the new inquiry for the Argentine, the #Vicario track is on standby as the bianconeri decide whether to accelerate or not. Furthermore, other names are also being evaluated in these hours. On the exit front, #Monza dreams of #DiGregorio's return.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]
The Dibu #Martínez track remains difficult for #Juventus. The bianconeri continue to follow other profiles. On the list are #Vicario, #Ederson, #Trubin and #Chevalier.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]
Talks are already advanced between Villa and Parma and Suzuki is keen on the move.[Ben Jacobs]

🔄 GOALKEEPER 🗣 Romeo Agresti on YT:"#Dibu is not doing very well health-wise. But from what we know, #Juve has asked for information again. We truly need to understand what his condition is. #Juve is making assessments. From what I have verified, this assault by the Villans on #Suzuki is based on the fact that #Dibu is not doing well.#Ederson: today this track was described to us as extremely expensive, complicated, crazy salary.... it was shut down for us...#Vicario: he must always be kept in mind... the easiest one to get, but if he hasn't been taken up to this day...."[@AverageJuventinoGuy]
.@PSG_inside is out of the race for Zion #Suzuki and does not plan to return to the topic. Now @AVFCOfficial can push to close the deal @SkySport[Di Marzio]
